programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team travels to Fitzwilliam, New Hampshire to investigate the Amos J. Blake House Museum. Then they head to the Arbona Building in Pensacola, Florida where books fall off shelves perfectly stacked.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga,located in upstate New York,is being haunted by the dead from three nationsand needs help from the TAPS team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: At Paddy Reilly's Bar in New York City, claims are that the activity is as hot after hours as it is when the bands are playing. The customers are gone but glasses are moving around and voices are speaking! \n\nNext the team moves on to the home of abolitionist and author Harriet Beecher Stowe, sadly without Jason who is home with his sick children. After making her name as the author of Uncle Tom's Cabin, Harriet became involved in spiritualism, hosting seances in her home. Stowe engaged a medium to help her communicate with her tragically deceased son.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team is off for The Southern Mansion in Cape May. Built as a summer home during the civil war, today it is an Inn that has a few guests that aren't checking in at the front desk. Dave Tango's father, Bruce, has experienced first hand some of the paranormal activity at the mansion and is joining the investigation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, once a notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. The team will be venturing into new territory in trying to communicate with the ghosts of young boys who made as much trouble when they were living as they're making dead.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters,TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant, Jason, and the rest of the TAPS team travel to beautiful Cape Cod to investigate the haunting history of the Orleans Inn. The inn's sordid past reaches back to the infamous goings-on inside its walls during its heyday in the Roaring 20's, and the current owners hope to rid the inn of the reported ghosts of years past.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team visits the home of the terrified Scully family who is ready to move. Mrs. Scully shows the team the hot spots starting in the living room that has confrontational shadows, adult legs walking up the stairs and spirits breathing down people's necks.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason, Grant and the rest of the TAPS team take a trip to Connecticut in order to search for conclusive evidence of paranormal activity inside Norwich State Hospital, a 100-year-old mental health facility that once housed the criminally insane.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY, has some 4 star claims! Employees are terrified by swinging doors and voices calling their names. Guests are freaking out after hearing non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs - when they're actually ON the top floor! Shadows, orbs, moaning; this massive hotel has it all!

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Philadelphia Zoo is the oldest in the country, but the reported Native American burial ground beneath it is even older. \n\nWhile there are no claims of animal ghosts, there are reports from the staff of disembodied voices, footsteps, apparitions and faces peeking through windows and misty shadows. There are 5 buildings to investigate, so the team has its hands quite full.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Ghost Hunters head to New England to investigate the historic 1875 Inn, where a series of tragic fires may have trapped the souls of its guests within its walls. Then, the crew heads to New Jersey to investigate a historic landmark built by one of America's founding fathers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS visits the location of the “shot heard round the world” at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is checking out the Rose Island Lighthouse off of Newport, R.I. where there's some unusual activity going on. Then later the team hits the world famous Baseball Hall of Fame in Cooperstown, where supposedly some famous athletes just can't seem to move on.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason, Grant and the TAPS team travels to St. Louis, Missouri, to investigate a mansion that was the generational home of the Lemp family, and the site where three of its members committed suicide in the span of only two generations.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason, Grant and the rest of the TAPS team travels to Alton, Illinois, to investigate the possibility of paranormal activity inside the former Milton School building, where the spirits of a murdered girl and her killer are believed to reside.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a home turned into a restaurant.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Taps heads to Fort William Henry located in Lake George, New York, where Ghost Hunters Academy winner Adam Berry joins the team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Alabama to investigate Sloss Furnaces, a 50-acre industrial plantoperating from 1882 until the 1970s.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Ghost Hunters enlist the help of Bravo's The Real Housewives of Atlanta as they embark on this week's investigation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Christmas Farm Inn in Jackson, N.H., and the Old Stone Fort in Schoharie, N.Y., are probed.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS crew is summoned to the city of Alexandria, Louisiana, by residents claiming that they have a haunted hotel, tavern and restaurant that need to be investigated; the town hosts an event for the ghost hunters to submit their findings.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The crew investigates the infamous Pennhurst Asylum in Pennsylvania, which is said to have a section in which ghosts can be heard playing the piano and a tunnel system where visions of dismembered torsos and a female ghost have been seen.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Oxford, Massachusetts to help a family in need. The house has been in the Voas family for two generations, and lots of activity has been reported, from apparitions to shadow figures.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is in Rapid City, South Dakota- at the foot of Mount Rushmore- investing the Hotel Alex Johnson. This place is so freaky that contractors have walked off the job and refused to return.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Mission Point Resort on Mackinac Island. Constructed in the 1950's as a summer destination, it becomes nearly deserted in the winter time, and perfect for the team to investigate.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels to a Civil War fort in Maine in order to explore claims of an evil presence that resides within its walls, and they later head to a home in North Carolina to investigate the sounds and physical contact that plague a family.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Ghost Hunters, Tapsheads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS travels to Hawaii to explore one of America's most sacred settings, Pearl Harbor. They are joined in their investigation of the Pacific Aviation Museum by Destination Truth's Josh Gates.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: We pick were we last left off, in Hawaii, for the reveal. Jason and Grant were called back for a very important personal case, the Reid House, in Rhode Island, to help a scared 4 year old.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team has been called out to investigate Hill View Manor in New Castle, Pennsylvania. Once a nursing facility, this now abandoned building is fraught with paranormal activity that allegedly stems from the violent deaths of former patients.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is summoned to Newport, R.I., to investigate Seaview Terrace, the setting for the gothic soap-opera, \.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS visits the Reed Homestead of Townsend, Massachusetts, where sightings of a ghostly grieving mother are reported. Next, they investigate stories of an apparition of a Confederate soldier at Summerseat Farm in Maryland.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates a site that once held violent riots between a legendary capitalist and the steel workers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates Hawaii's Plantation Village in Waipahu, where sightings of a ghostly girl and possibly haunted artifacts are reported. Later, the team visits Ventfort Hall in Lenox, Massachusetts.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason along with daughter Haily, visit a house to investigate child ghosts who occasionally bounce balls and are heard walking back and forth on the third floor. Jason allows Haily to take the lead on her first investigation, as he believes that child ghosts are more apt to make contact with younger females. The group just might have thought correctly after Haily hears whispering voices.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team is the first paranormal team to ever investigate the infamous Friar’s Club in New York City.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Ghost Hunters, the team heads to Rapids Theater in Niagara Falls, New York where a lonely actress hanged herself backstage. The staff believes her spirit has never left and is haunting the theater.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Special guest investigator Meredith Vieira joins the TAPS team, as they investigate Sailors' Snug Harbor in Staten Island, New York. Once a retirement home to weathered seaman, it's now home to the spirit of a murdered matron.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called out to Jefferson City, Missouri, to investigate the notorious Missouri State Penitentiary. A prison that was once named one of the most violent prisons in America. Riots, stabbings and executions left thousands dead over the years -- resulting in an abandoned prison full of ghostly inmates.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads back to the fan favorite; Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Kentucky, an abandoned tuberculosis hospital haunted by its former patients and staff.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Natalia Machado starts with her husband's favourite dish--shepherd's pie, or pastel de papa. Along with the classic mashed potatoes, ground beef and corn, she gives it an Argentinian flavour with tomatoes, olives, hardboiled egg and, of course, some Malbec wine. Next, she shows us how easy it is to make your own spätzle and serves it up with pan fried paprika shrimp. The quintessential Argentinian comfort food, humitas, is next on the menu. A kind of fresh corn polenta, it's simply made with grated corn on the cob, onions, chili flakes and sweet basil. Finally, compote pears done two ways-one with classic Argentinian flavours, including Malbec, cardamom and orange zest. The other with a Canadian twist-poached in maple syrup, apple juice and cinnamon.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Vanessa Gianfrancesco prepares an Italian feast with classic flavours and remarkable textures. First, she cooks a crispy yet juicy porchetta (pork belly) with an orange, sage and fennel marinade and a side of crackling roasted potatoes. Then on to an airy focaccia given an extra flavour punch with black olives and fresh rosemary. Crisp rapini becomes wilted once Vanessa gives it a toss in some warm olive oil, sundried tomatoes, onion, and garlic. And finally, she combines all the dishes to create an incredible pizza topped with all of the different flavours and textures of Italy.

programme.desc:
Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home.

The Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Natalia Machado starts with her husband's favourite dish--shepherd's pie, or pastel de papa. Along with the classic mashed potatoes, ground beef and corn, she gives it an Argentinian flavour with tomatoes, olives, hardboiled egg and, of course, some Malbec wine. Next, she shows us how easy it is to make your own spätzle and serves it up with pan fried paprika shrimp. The quintessential Argentinian comfort food, humitas, is next on the menu. A kind of fresh corn polenta, it's simply made with grated corn on the cob, onions, chili flakes and sweet basil. Finally, compote pears done two ways-one with classic Argentinian flavours, including Malbec, cardamom and orange zest. The other with a Canadian twist-poached in maple syrup, apple juice and cinnamon.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Vanessa Gianfrancesco prepares an Italian feast with classic flavours and remarkable textures. First, she cooks a crispy yet juicy porchetta (pork belly) with an orange, sage and fennel marinade and a side of crackling roasted potatoes. Then on to an airy focaccia given an extra flavour punch with black olives and fresh rosemary. Crisp rapini becomes wilted once Vanessa gives it a toss in some warm olive oil, sundried tomatoes, onion, and garlic. And finally, she combines all the dishes to create an incredible pizza topped with all of the different flavours and textures of Italy.

programme.title: How The Nazis Lost The War
programme.desc: Told through the lens of the bumbling generals and paranoid Fuhrer who had hit the big time by tragic accident. Hitler's war machine was feared and ruthless - at least for a time. It cut a swathe through Europe and North Africa and threatened to overrun Russia. From 1939 into the early 1940s Hitler's dream of a Third Reich and dominance over all of Europe was a distinct possibility. But then cracks appeared. The war machine became vulnerable. The history of WWII is usually told through the eyes of the victors - but How the Nazis Lost the War is told through the lens of the bumbling generals and paranoid Fuhrer who had hit the big time by tragic accident. For the first time, How the Nazis Lost the War tells the decline of Hitler's empire from the inside out - showing how a dysfunctional, bloated, poorly led gang of thugs managed to fool Germany, then take Europe by surprise.
